newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 13.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 13.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Friday were capped as sellers eventually emerged. Shipowners' enquiries had increased amid fears that prices would rise further on Gulf tensions. A major was heard to have sold out of bunker fuel. While some sellers were aggressive on offers, others held back, expecting prices to firm further. Bunker 180 cst was quoted at $123-$124, 380-cst at $117.5, easing off from mid Friday's high levels. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082).
